received.title: New offer received
received.body: You received an offer of ${amount} on your listing.

accepted.title: Offer accepted
accepted.body: Your offer of ${amount} has been accepted. Please proceed to payment.

rejected.title: Offer rejected
rejected.body: Your offer of ${amount} was rejected by the vendor.

approved.title: Listing approved
approved.body: Your vehicle listing is now live on the platform.

escrowed.title: Payment received
escrowed.body: A buyer has paid for your vehicle. Please arrange delivery to release your funds.

released.title: Funds released
released.body: Your payment of ${amount} has been released to your wallet.

approved.title: Withdrawal approved
approved.body: Your withdrawal of ${amount} has been approved and is being processed.

paid.title: Withdrawal paid
paid.body: Your withdrawal of ${amount} has been transferred to your bank account.

rejected.title: Withdrawal rejected
rejected.body: Your withdrawal of ${amount} was rejected. Reason: ${reason}. Funds have been returned to your wallet.

otp.subject: Your verification code — C2C Vehicles
otp.heading: Your verification code
otp.body: Use the code below to verify your account. It expires in ${minutes} minutes.
otp.footer: If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.

welcome.subject: Welcome to C2C Vehicles
welcome.heading: Welcome aboard!
welcome.body: Your account has been verified successfully. You can now browse, list, and buy vehicles on C2C Vehicles.

offerReceived.subject: New offer on your listing — C2C Vehicles
offerReceived.heading: You have a new offer
offerReceived.body: A buyer has placed an offer of ${amount} on your listing. Log in to review and respond.

offerAccepted.subject: Your offer was accepted — C2C Vehicles
offerAccepted.heading: Offer accepted!
offerAccepted.body: Great news! Your offer of ${amount} has been accepted. Please proceed to complete payment.

offerRejected.subject: Your offer was not accepted — C2C Vehicles
offerRejected.heading: Offer not accepted
offerRejected.body: Unfortunately your offer of ${amount} was not accepted by the vendor.

listingApproved.subject: Your listing is live — C2C Vehicles
listingApproved.heading: Listing approved!
listingApproved.body: Your vehicle listing has been reviewed and approved. It is now visible to buyers on the platform.

listingRejected.subject: Your listing needs attention — C2C Vehicles
listingRejected.heading: Listing not approved
listingRejected.body: Your listing was reviewed and could not be approved. Reason: ${reason}. Please update your listing and resubmit.

paymentEscrowed.subject: Payment received for your vehicle — C2C Vehicles
paymentEscrowed.heading: Payment is in escrow
paymentEscrowed.body: A buyer has completed payment for your vehicle. Please arrange delivery. Once the buyer confirms receipt, funds will be released to your wallet.

paymentReleased.subject: Funds released to your wallet — C2C Vehicles
paymentReleased.heading: Funds released!
paymentReleased.body: Your payment of ${amount} has been released and is now available in your wallet.

invoiceReady.subject: Invoice ${invoiceNumber} — C2C Vehicles
invoiceReady.heading: Your invoice is ready
invoiceReady.buyerBody: Your purchase invoice ${invoiceNumber} is ready. Click the button below to download your PDF invoice.
invoiceReady.vendorBody: Your sale invoice ${invoiceNumber} is ready. Click the button below to download your PDF invoice.

approved.subject: Withdrawal approved — C2C Vehicles
approved.heading: Withdrawal approved
approved.body: Your withdrawal of ${amount} has been approved and is being processed to your bank account.

paid.subject: Withdrawal sent to your bank — C2C Vehicles
paid.heading: Withdrawal paid
paid.body: Your withdrawal of ${amount} has been transferred to your bank account.

rejected.subject: Withdrawal could not be processed — C2C Vehicles
rejected.heading: Withdrawal rejected
rejected.body: Your withdrawal of ${amount} could not be processed. Reason: ${reason}. The funds have been returned to your wallet.
